# OpenToonz

## ⚠️ **重要提示**

**请仅从官方来源下载：** OpenToonz 的官方网站只有 [**opentoonz.github.io**](https://opentoonz.github.io/) 和此 [GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz)。为保障安全，请勿从其他域名下载 OpenToonz；OpenToonz 没有其他官方镜像或合作下载站点。

[English](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/README.md) [日本語](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/README_ja.md) 

[![](https://ci.appveyor.com/api/projects/status/oa5l5pc964h8fv49/branch/master?svg=true)](https://ci.appveyor.com/project/opentoonz/opentoonz)
[![Build Windows](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/actions/workflows/workflow_windows.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/actions/workflows/workflow_windows.yml)
[![Build macOS](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/actions/workflows/workflow_macos.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/actions/workflows/workflow_macos.yml)
[![Build Linux](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/actions/workflows/workflow_linux.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/actions/workflows/workflow_linux.yml)
[![Translation status](https://hosted.weblate.org/widgets/opentoonz/-/svg-badge.svg)](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/opentoonz/)

## 关于OpenToonz

OpenToonz 是一个由[DWANGO](http://dwango.co.jp/english/)公开发布的二维动画软件，基于**Toonz Studio 吉卜力版本**， 最早由意大利公司[Digital Video, Inc.](http://www.toonz.com/)开发，并在多年的生产中为[吉卜力工作室](http://www.ghibli.jp/) 定制。

## 系统要求

请参考OpenToonz的官方网站：

<https://opentoonz.github.io/e/index.html>

## 安装

最新的安装包可以从这里下载：

<https://opentoonz.github.io/e/index.html>.

旧版本以及夜间构建版可以从下面的链接下载: <https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/releases>

## 开发

- [开发检查清单（草稿）](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/development_checklist.md)
- [AI 辅助开发检查清单（草稿）](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/ai_assisted_development_checklist.md)

## 如何在本地构建

- [Windows](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_build_win_chs.md)
- [macOS](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_build_macosx.md)
- [Linux](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_build_linux.md)
- [BSD](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_build_bsd.md)

关于如何构建样式表，请参照[这里](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_stylesheet.md).

不懂开发但仍想帮忙？你可以帮助我们测试拉取请求，详情请查阅[这里](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_test_prs_chs.md)。

## 社区

- 分享使用心得或进行问题排查，请加入 [谷歌OpenToonz用户论坛](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/opentoonz_en)。
- 如果你在问题排查后发现了bug，或者你是个开发者，可以在 [Github issues](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/issues) 页搜索或发布。

## 文档

- 一般文档请[参阅此处](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz_docs)。

## 许可证

- 对于`thirdparty` 以及`stuff/library/mypaint brushes` 文件夹以外的内容基于Modified BSD License分发
  - [modified BSD license](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/LICENSE.txt).
  - 基于该许可证，该软件可以被自由用于个人或商业目的使用或修改。
- 对于 `thirdparty` 文件夹内的内容：
  - 请参考对应的README或源码中的许可证。
- 对于 `stuff/library/mypaint brushes` 文件夹下的内容：
  - 请查看 `stuff/library/mypaint brushes/Licenses.txt` 的内容。

### 特别感谢

原始程序从Toonz开发而来，这是一个由意大利罗马的公司 Digital Video, S.p.A.所开发的软件。

## 参与翻译

有关提交翻译文件以及审核、合并和更新翻译的流程，请参阅
[翻译指南（英文）](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/toonz/sources/translations/README.md)。

Qt Linguist 编辑方式和现有的手动翻译工具仍然受支持。

# OpenToonz

## ⚠️ **Important**

**OFFICIAL SOURCE ONLY:** The only official websites for OpenToonz are [**opentoonz.github.io**](https://opentoonz.github.io/) and this [GitHub repository](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz). To ensure your security, please avoid downloading OpenToonz from any other domain, as there are no other official mirrors or partner sites.

[日本語](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/README_ja.md) [简体中文](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/README_chs.md)

[![Build macOS](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/actions/workflows/workflow_macos.yml/badge.svg?branch=master)](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/actions/workflows/workflow_macos.yml)

## What is OpenToonz?

OpenToonz is a 2D animation software published by 
[DWANGO](http://dwango.co.jp/english/). It is based on **Toonz Studio
Ghibli Version**, originally developed in Italy by
[Digital Video, Inc.](http://www.toonz.com/), and customized by
[Studio Ghibli](http://www.ghibli.jp/) over many years of production.

## Program Requirements

Please refer to the OpenToonz site at <https://opentoonz.github.io/e/index.html>.

## Installation

Please download and install OpenToonz from the latest installer at <https://opentoonz.github.io/e/index.html>.

Older versions and unstable nightly builds are also available at <https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/releases>.

## Development

- [Development checklist (draft)](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/development_checklist.md)
- [AI-assisted development checklist (draft)](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/ai_assisted_development_checklist.md)

## How to Build Locally

- [Windows](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_build_win.md)
- [macOS](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_build_macosx.md)
- [Linux](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_build_linux.md)
- [BSD](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_build_bsd.md)

For instructions on how to build stylesheets, please [see here](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_stylesheet.md).

Can't develop but still want to help? Help us test individual Pull Requests before they are merged with [these steps](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/doc/how_to_test_prs.md).

## Community

- To share tips or to troubleshoot, join the [Google OpenToonz Users forum](https://groups.google.com/forum/#!forum/opentoonz_en)
- If you found a bug with the software after troubleshooting, or are a developer, search the [Github issues](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/issues) and post there.

## Documentation

- For general documentation, please [look here](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz_docs).

## Licensing

- Files outside of the `thirdparty` and `stuff/library/mypaint brushes` directories are based on the Modified BSD License.
  - [modified BSD license](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/LICENSE.txt).
  - Based on this license, this software may be used or changed freely for business or personal use.
- For files in the `thirdparty` directory:
  - Please consult with the licenses in the appropriate READMEs or source codes.
- For files in the `stuff/library/mypaint brushes` directory:
  - Please see the licenses in `stuff/library/mypaint brushes/Licenses.txt`.

### Special Thanks

This open-source program is developed from Toonz, a software originally created by Digital Video, S.p.A., Rome, Italy

## Contributing translations

To share updated translation files or review, merge, and refresh catalogs, see
[Contributing and maintaining translations](https://github.com/opentoonz/opentoonz/blob/572d59ac5fedfeaf7910967b439c6b8d73c9c3e1/toonz/sources/translations/README.md).
Qt Linguist editing and existing manual translation tools remain supported.
